en.headline: EMSD finds 78 private buildings with missing lift door frames by Tai Zoom
en.dek: Inspections as of Saturday afternoon identified the additional cases beyond two public estates; the contractor will pay for all remedial work under supervision.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said inspections of lifts installed by Tai Zoom Elevator (Hong Kong) had identified 78 private buildings where fire-resisting landing door frames were missing, as of 2pm on Saturday.

The department said property management companies and owners’ corporations of the affected buildings had been or would be notified. Installation of the frames will take place under EMSD supervision, with Tai Zoom bearing all costs. Work has already started at one of the two public estates previously identified, and the remaining buildings will follow as soon as possible.

Because more missing frames were found and similar problems are expected on other Tai Zoom projects, the department has mobilised the lift contractors’ association and other firms to speed up the installations. It has also ordered all registered lift contractors to review landing-door work from the past decade and submit declarations by 15 November. A dedicated webpage tracks the progress of inspections and repairs.

zh.headline: 機電署確認臺日升降機78幢私樓缺門框組件
zh.dek: 截至周六下午巡查，除兩個租置屋邨外共78幢私人樓宇未裝耐火門框，補裝費用由承辦商承擔，署方已動員商會協助加快工程。
body: 機電工程署表示，因應臺日電梯（香港）有限公司完成更換的升降機沒有安裝門框組件，署方已展開巡查。截至星期六下午兩時，除早前公布的兩個租置屋邨外，共有78幢樓宇的臺日升降機沒有安裝門框組件，全部是私人樓宇。
署方指，相關樓宇的物業管理公司或業主立案法團已經或將獲通知。門框組件安裝工程將在機電署監督下進行，所有費用由承辦商承擔。其中一個租置屋邨的安裝工程已展開，其餘樓宇會盡快展開。
由於發現更多缺失，且預計該承辦商其他工程可能出現同樣問題，機電署已動員升降機商會或其他承建商協助，盡快完成安裝。署方亦已要求其他註冊承辦商審視過去十年層站門工程，並於11月15日前提交聲明。署方已設立專頁展示巡查及安裝進度。
